title: Twin-Court Maul of the Monarch Stage
summary: A paired manual for Monarch-stage bearers that crushes in twin strokes and ends in one court-ending fall.

title: Hawk and Basin: The Great Maul
summary: Teaches the great maul from the hawk's height down into the basin with a field of qi behind each fall.

title: River-Breaking Paired Maul Canon
summary: A canon of breaking a surging river of enemies with paired maul strokes and a flood-tide slam.

title: Azure Court Treatise on the Falling Maul
summary: Treatise on the falling maul as practiced at the azure court with paired knee blows and a great fall.

title: Basin-Stone and Hawk-Wing Maul Method
summary: A method joining the heavy basin-stone blow to the sweeping hawk-wing stroke inside one qi field.

title: Dual-Track Mastery of the Thunder Maul
summary: Mastery of the thunder maul along two tracks at once ending in the single stroke of the two thunders.

title: Oath-Maul for the Monarch Stage
summary: A wind-sworn manual that binds a Monarch-stage bearer to one oath bearing and one falling stroke.

title: Plateau-Breaker: The Gale Maul Course
summary: A course in breaking stone and ranks at the plateau's edge with the gale driving each maul blow.

title: The Bearing Taken and the Maul Kept
summary: Teaches the bearer to take a bearing in the wind and keep the maul on it to the end.

title: Treatise on the Oath Maul and the Open Plateau
summary: Treatise on swinging the sworn maul across the open plateau where no wall shelters the bearer.

title: Gale Rites of the Sworn Hammer-Head
summary: Rites that swear the maul head to the gale and end in the final rite of the sworn head.

title: The Maul of No Walls
summary: A manual of fighting in open country with the maul and no shelter but the bearer's own guard.
